lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid-like array of high-intensity circular pixel clusters positioned posterior to the branchial region, arranged in vertical columns of approximately 5-7 blobs each across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with the circular high-intensity blobs, forming a matrix of grid-like anchor nodes along the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal linear feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with a high-luminance upper edge and a shadowed lower edge running parallel to the dorsal midline.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of discrete high-luminance blobs is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with spots appearing more diffuse than those on the primary flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical low-luminance linear mark is visible immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, appearing as a deep crease or unique temporal feature.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region and rostrum exhibit a significantly higher spatial frequency of smaller high-luminance points compared to the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the posterior flank.
